journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports
population: Healthy adults in the HUNT Fitness Study
limitations: Equation may not generalise to clinical populations
title: Age-predicted maximal heart rate in healthy subjects: The HUNT Fitness Study

keyFinding.enGB: In a large healthy Norwegian sample, maximal heart rate was better described by 211 − 0.64×age than by 220 − age.
keyFinding.uk: У великій вибірці здорових норвежців максимальна ЧСС краще описується як 211 − 0,64×вік, ніж 220 − вік.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Large population fitness cohort with measured HRmax; still population-specific.
